title: Podkletnov's father retrieved Schauberger's files

tellings.quote: Schauberger cuz his dad was actually a Soviet agent that retrieved Victor Schauberger's files.

plain: The father of a scientist named Eugene Podkletnov is said to have been a Soviet agent who recovered the files of the inventor Viktor Schauberger, around the 1940s. Michels says this himself, in an episode with a guest named Dave Rossi, without naming a source. If true, it would link Podkletnov's own work to Schauberger's ideas through his family.
